description: A certification request produced by OpenSSL carrying the RFC 7633 TLS Feature extension, used as the independent producer for where that extension is placed in a request.
command: openssl req -new -newkey ec -pkeyopt ec_paramgen_curve:prime256v1 -nodes -keyout tf.key -out tf.csr -outform DER -subj "/CN=must-staple.example" -addext "tlsfeature=status_request"
